title: (No AI) McKinsey is making job applicants spar with a fake AI client
author: Jay Peters
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/STK414_AI_CVIRGINIA_2_C-2.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Consulting firm McKinsey & Company is going to ask some entry-level candidates to have a 10-minute conversation with an AI simulation of a client as part of the interview process, [according to _The Wall Street Journal_](https://www.wsj.com/lifestyle/careers/mckinsey-interview-process-ai-7d08a69e).

The AI simulation "aims to reflect 80% of the scenarios McKinsey consultants might encounter in their day-to-day work," the _WSJ_ says, and it isn't designed to "mimic an unhinged client." The AI won't score the candidates - humans will be in the room to assess the candidates and see how well they deal with the simulated situations.

title: (No AI) Eight states sue OpenAI, saying ChatGPT isn’t safe for kids
author: Emma Roth
content:
![Vector illustration of the ChatGPT logo.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/25462005/STK155_OPEN_AI_CVirginia_B.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

OpenAI is facing a new wave of lawsuits from eight US states that accuse the company of harming children and misleading customers about the safety of ChatGPT, [as reported earlier by _Reuters_](https://www.reuters.com/world/eight-us-states-sue-openai-claiming-chatgpt-harms-children-2026-10-14/). The lawsuits, filed separately by Iowa, Kansas, Nebraska, West Virginia, Arkansas, Arizona, Idaho, and Montana, allege OpenAI unlawfully put profits over safety when developing ChatGPT.

The string of complaints claims that OpenAI violated local consumer protection laws by failing to warn customers about the dangers of ChatGPT, citing several lawsuits filed [by the family members](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/928691/openai-chatgpt-wrongful-death-overdose) [of teens and](https://www.theverge.com/news/831207/openai-chatgpt-lawsuit-parental-controls-tos) [adults](https://www.theverge.com/news/842494/openai-chatgpt-wrongful-death-suzanne-adams-delusions) that allege the AI chatbot played a role in their loved …
